purpose: Search and reference index for decisions; verify provider details again when changing an integration.

ipsum.summary: Daily aggregated suspicious IP feed; level N includes IPs appearing in at least N source lists. A listing is not proof of abuse. The repository declares the Unlicense; review upstream terms and freshness.

cloudflare_ip_lists.summary: Managed threat lists have account/plan restrictions. Public Cloudflare proxy ranges identify infrastructure, not malicious visitors.

turnstile.summary: The frontend uses a public site key; backend Siteverify is mandatory and uses a secret. Tokens expire and are single-use; check expected hostname/action and handle outages.

sealed_boxes.summary: Libsodium sealed boxes encrypt to a recipient key but do not authenticate the sender or prevent replay; code/key distribution must be independently trusted.

machine_id.summary: Raw machine IDs are confidential; application-specific derivation is preferable to exposure, though identifiers remain forgeable and linkable.

device_intelligence.summary: See the existing source-linked research report for attestation, fingerprinting, privacy and false-positive limitations.

request_replay.summary: A single-use verifier nonce and bounded validity can help reject repeated proofs, but do not prevent a first-use race or authenticate the sender. This prototype does not implement HTTP message signatures.

trusted_proxy.summary: Only trust security-relevant client IP headers at a deliberately configured, protected proxy boundary; untrusted forwarding values can be spoofed.

github_checkout.summary: Checkout v7.0.1 uses the Node 24 runtime; checkout v6 and later retain credentials in RUNNER_TEMP and support subsequent host git operations. This workflow runs on GitHub-hosted Linux.

browser_crypto.summary: libsodium-wrappers 0.8.4 supplies crypto_box_seal after ready; esbuild bundles for browsers. A CSP must allow WebAssembly compilation when needed; sender code and same-page third-party scripts remain trusted.

python_socket_server.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. ThreadingMixIn starts request threads and daemon_threads controls shutdown behavior; socket timeouts apply to blocking operations while shutdown closes the connection. Neither cancels arbitrary application work or establishes production safety.

wsgi_trust_context.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. PEP 3333 describes environ and notes REMOTE_USER may be absent if no authentication occurred. An application must verify the server/middleware trust contract; client-provided headers and signals are not authenticated context.

platform_clocks_and_mutex.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. Proposed Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC, macOS CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW and Windows QueryUnbiasedInterruptTime intend to exclude sleep; ordinary-user native sleep/resume validation remains outstanding. QPC includes sleep. Windows SRW locks are initialized and not moved while in use.

platform_entropy.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. Linux getrandom with GRND_NONBLOCK fails if entropy is not ready and requires Linux 3.17+ and a compatible libc/seccomp policy; Windows BCryptGenRandom system-preferred and macOS SecRandomCopyBytes are experimental. Never infer measured entropy or production security from a smoke test.

cmake_packaging.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. Use install/export targets, a generated relocatable package config and explicit dependencies; use relative build/install RPATH where supported. An ABI identifier is not a declared release version.

windows_smbios.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. RSMB firmware access uses size query plus bounded read; DMTF defines the header/string-set and 2.6 UUID field byte order. Neither availability nor syntax proves authenticity, uniqueness or permission. Pre-2.6 UUID byte order is uncertain.

macos_cf_uuid_and_policy.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22: CoreFoundation type IDs and Create/Copy ownership support a bounded synthetic validation boundary. Apple describes fingerprinting restrictions; technical access or tracking consent is not policy permission. Hardware collection is not implemented.

observation_index.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22: Python dictionary insertion ordering is defined, set order is not. Explicit monotonically assigned IDs preserve tie ordering. SQLite explains indexed OR-term rowid union. Worst-case candidate/cleanup cost remains capacity-sized.

bounded_expiry_heap.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22: Python heapq documents priority update and tombstone challenges. The experimental indexed heap updates in place with a position map to bound memory to one entry per live observation; bounded cleanup denies on backlog.

gcc_analyzer_triage.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22: GCC static analysis can have false positives, false negatives and complexity cutoffs. RFC 6234 describes SHA-256 schedule dependencies; local SHA diagnostic is likely a loop-analysis false positive, original JSON diagnostic not reproduced.

bounded_json_output.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22: snprintf returns a negative value on error and the would-have-written byte count on success, excluding the terminator; compare against buffer capacity to detect truncation.

operational_metrics.summary: Accessed 2026-11-22. Prometheus warns that unbounded dimensions create a time series for each label combination; user or device identifiers must not become metric labels. The experimental fixed-schema snapshot is not a Prometheus exporter.
